[[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] tried to get [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]] to join him while they fought alone on Cloud City. Most dark players, however, will want to use this card when [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]] is the key character in a defensive force, giving light a difficult choice. If [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] can hit [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]] with a lightsaber, this card makes light either remove him from the battle immediately--perhaps leaving a very weak group to face the power of the Dark Lord--or keep him in the fight, but lose him permanently to the Dark Side at the end of the battle.

This card gives Hunt Down decks a new weapon to use against [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]] to help counter all the new dueling cards. But any deck that uses [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] and his lightsaber and expects to run into [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]]--that is to say, almost every Dark deck--might be able to find a space for this powerful card.
